status: line described by the maintainer, 21 Oct 2026; matching unverified
line: The maintainer's description (21 Oct 2026): Become the Shadow Lord banishes Arknight Descendancy (blue), creating a Runechant; Descendancy is activated, creating 3 Runechants on banish; it then costs only 2 to play: 1 to activate the Gate, and 1 to make up the cost after the Runechant reduction. Banishing and Runechants aren't logged, so the chain matches the logged parts: Become the Shadow Lord played, a Gate used and Descendancy played, all in the same turn.
expectation: Written 21 Oct 2026, before measuring this chain (seen beforehand: Descendancy is in 80% of lists and played about 0.5 times a game; 82 of the broader chain's completions were same-turn; not seen: how many of those involved Descendancy). 1. How often: of Viserai sides that play Become the Shadow Lord, 10-25% complete this line in a single turn; of the broader chain's same-turn completions, over half have Descendancy as the card played through the Gate. 2. When: early, with a median setup turn of 2 or 3. 3. Result: compared with sides that play Become the Shadow Lord without a same-turn payoff, at similar life totals on that turn, completing it wins 5-15 points more often and deals more damage that turn. No difference in wins but more damage means a tempo play, not a game-winner; neither means the proxy isn't capturing the line.
